data.name: Ferret's Grace
data.description: A heister gains Stealthy as a bonus feat. Additionally, a heister counts as a creature one size category smaller than she actually is when determining whether or not she is squeezing into an enclosed space (Core Rulebook p193-194). Finally, when a heister uses the Escape Artist skill to move through a tight space where her head fits but her shoulders do not (Core Rulebook p95-96), the DC is 20, instead of 30.
